rule: A session may be priced only by the latest archived snapshot whose own stamp (and, where recorded, whose git commit) is earlier than that session's 05:00 London start. A snapshot marked after a session can never price it, so re-marking the ladder cannot back-date history.
why_this_exists: data/l2l-levels.json is a live marking tool file: it is re-marked in place, so today's copy cannot establish what was in the file before an old session. The snapshots below are the dated copies that can.

evidence.tick_sweep_record: data/usd-layer1-backtester/l2l-tick-sweep-v1.json records this exact sha256 as the ladder it replayed, and six sessions 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-12
evidence.timing: the stamp (2026-10-04T16:14:19Z), the latest hand mark (2026-10-04T15:28:46.601Z) and the commit (2026-10-04T19:02:52Z) all precede the first priced session start, 2026-10-05T04:00:00Z

not_a_snapshot.why: the live file was automatically re-marked on 2026-11-23 (stamp 2026-11-23T16:20:57.042Z, 30 levels per asset). It is a candidate for future sessions only and cannot establish eligibility for any session before its stamp.
